messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Output for Hyper/Hypo Methylated bases
parts:
Thanks for the Info, we are looking at soybean with 20 chromosomes. This is a link to the assembly:
 ftp://ftp.jgi-psf.org/pub/compgen/phytozome/v9.0/Gmax/

code:
methRaw_CpG <- read(location = file.list, sample.id = list("Rep1", "Rep2"), assembly = "glyma1", treatment = c(0,1), context="CpG")

pdf(file="test.pdf")
sink("test.txt")

filtered.methRaw_CpG <- filterByCoverage(methRaw_CpG, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)
tiles <- tileMethylCounts(methRaw_CpG, win.size = 100, step.size = 100)
meth <- unite(tiles, destrand=T)
myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(meth)
myDiff25p.hyper <- get.methylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hyper")
myDiff25p.hypo <- get.methylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hypo")
myDiff25p <- get.methylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01)

diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = T, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)
diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = F, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)

sink()
dev.off()

Im sorry for any lack of information Im just working as an intern now but don't have any experience in the biology field.
also Im trying to get the information that is given in some of the examples from commands like:
as(myDiff, "GRanges")
but this skips a lot of data in the middle. Is there a way to redirect the full output from this to a file. Im trying to get info like head(promoters[[1]]) etc. as well but can only seem to get anything out when I type it in R interactive mode. I thought maybe the sink(filename) command would do this but none of this information seems to be going to the file.
